answer.reason: Lebanon is a region, so only its defining event qualifies: it supplied cedar for Solomon's building of the LORD's house, and the rest of the verses only mark boundaries or use it in comparisons.

clauses.english: yielded cedar trees for Solomon's building of the house of the LORD
clauses.quote: command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon

doubts: Many marked verses (Psalms, Isaiah, Song of Solomon, Hosea, Ezekiel) use Lebanon only as a figure or comparison, so they were left out.
JOS 11:17 and JOS 12:7 mention the valley of Lebanon only as a boundary of Joshua's conquests, so no clause was written from them.
1KI 5:14, 1KI 7:2, 1KI 9:19 and the Ezra passage show Solomon's work in Lebanon or its timber, but I treated them as detail of the same story rather than separate events.
